music.prompt: Professional modern instrumental background music for a 30-second education software advert aimed at university lecturers, mixed as a bed under a spoken voice-over: keep the midrange sparse and leave room for speech. Starts tense and mechanical: a low ticking pulse and muted staccato strings, like pressure building, about 100 BPM, speeding up slightly from 3 seconds. At 6.5 seconds a short clean break, then it opens up into warm, confident, curious music: felt piano, soft pulsing synth bass, light tasteful drums, gentle strings. Lifts once more at 21 seconds and resolves with a clean ending at 30 seconds. Polished, intelligent, understated. Instrumental only. No vocals, no bells, no chimes, no sound effects, no risers, no whooshes.

voices.text: The physics fits on one line.
Write it the way you would on the board.
When a student asks why, press Explain.
